description: This file defines a custom NSView subclass and a SwiftUI view representable for displaying highlighted menu items with mouse tracking and highlight updates for a macOS app.

classes.name: HighlightedMenuItemHostView
classes.description: A custom NSView subclass managing mouse hover tracking and highlighting for menu items.

methods.name: init(rootView:width:)
methods.description: Initializes the view with a root SwiftUI view and a specified width, setting up hosting and layout.

methods.name: update(rootView:width:)
methods.description: Updates the hosted view's content and size based on new parameters.

methods.name: updateHighlight()
methods.description: Updates the highlighted state of the view based on hover status.

methods.name: updateSizing()
methods.description: Adjusts the size of the hosting view and the frame based on current width.

methods.name: intrinsicContentSize
methods.description: Provides the intrinsic size based on the hosting view's fitting size.

methods.name: updateTrackingAreas()
methods.description: Sets up mouse tracking regions for hover detection.

methods.name: mouseEntered(with:)
methods.description: Handles mouse entering the view area, setting hover state.

methods.name: mouseExited(with:)
methods.description: Handles mouse exiting the view area, clearing hover state.

methods.name: layout()
methods.description: Lays out subviews and updates hosting frame.
